name: Homework in words
description: Turns myHomework's answer into what the homework page draws (DBU-06): with no ?step, the list of the learner's homework; with one, the homework card, where the newest hand-in stands, the next version's number, and the versions. Keys and the values for their {tags}; dates in the learner's zone (their profile's, else the browser's). It decides nothing the server has not.
